 Weekly Recap: Q3 revenue growth, higher 2026 guidance and CFO changes
 Less than 1 min read IONQ IonQ, Inc. (NYSE:IONQ) reported third-quarter revenue of $173.8 million, up 336% year over year, and raised 2026 guidance to $505–$515 million. CFO Inder M. Singh left immediately, and Commvault CFO Gary Merrill will become CFO and treasurer in early December 2026. 
 Previous Week Recap 
 Revenue Surge, Guidance Raised : IonQ reported Q3 revenue of $173.8 million, up 336% year over year, and raised 2026 guidance to $505–$515 million. Adjusted EBITDA loss was $133.6 million; cash and investments totaled $1.7 billion. 
 2 sources 
 CFO Transition And Appointments : IonQ said CFO Inder M. Singh left immediately. Commvault CFO Gary Merrill was named CFO and treasurer, starting in early December 2026. Thomas A. Austin became chief accounting officer immediately. 
 3 sources 
 Singh Steps Down Immediately : IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) said Inder M. Singh stepped down from his roles at the company, effective immediately. 
 Reuters 
 Austin Named Chief Accounting Officer : IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) appointed Thomas A. Austin, formerly Juniper Networks’ chief accounting officer, to the newly created role of chief accounting officer, effective immediately. 
 BusinessWire 
 Carahsoft Named Public Sector Distributor : IonQ named Carahsoft Technology its public sector distributor, expanding government procurement and sales access for its quantum computing, networking, sensing and security technologies.
